title: Other musicians stationed at Great Lakes
summary: Names include Ross McConnell, Gerald Wilson, Al Grey, Lou Donaldson, Osie Johnson.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Ross McConnell, from Benny Carter’s band. There was Hobart Dodson. There was . . .
Yeah. There was Gerald Wilson. There was Paul Campbell, who used to play with Lester Young. There were so many cats in there . . .
Al Grey was there. Also Louis – Louie – Lou Donaldson, the saxophone player. Lou Donaldson was there.
Osie Johnson, yeah, absolutely. Man, those cats are all over the place.
